searchText: btw, https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/218 would benefit from more EL implementer eyes - we have some details with regards to error conditions and response ordering to work out, then it would be good to go What about running a handful of "full" CLs that are explicitly trusted by your light clients, would that allow the light client to stay on the current slot? We'd be very interested in a topology where we run a handful of full CL/EL pairs that then drive consensus for the rest of our fleet (running EL and a light CL), _especially_ if doing so would help ensure a more consistent view of the network across the EL fleet.
